candidates.sentence: The RFI would seek feedback on approaches to: identify culturally competent and evidence-based interventions in populations served by these programs; reduce costs in Medicare and Medicaid; increase patient satisfaction for Medicare and Medicaid beneficiaries; identify beneficiaries’ health insurance literacy levels; and identify ways for CMS to use Medicare and Medicaid pay policies to improve health literacy.
